title: Sending your files

paused.user: The upload is paused. Resume it when you are ready: it continues where it stopped.
paused.failures: The connection keeps failing, so the upload is paused. Check your network connection, then resume: it continues where it stopped.

actions.confirmCancel: Cancel this transfer? The files already sent will be deleted.

leaveWarning: Files are still being sent. Leaving this page interrupts the upload.

announce.completed: All files sent. The antivirus analysis is starting.
announce.error: The upload stopped because of an error.

error.unauthenticated: Your session has expired. Identify yourself again, then select the same files to resume.
error.forbidden: Sending these files is no longer allowed. Start a new transfer or contact your administrator.
error.upload-gone: This upload has expired or no longer exists. Start a new transfer.
error.payload-too-large: A file is larger than the size declared or allowed. Start a new transfer.
error.insufficient-storage: The server has run out of storage space. Try again later or contact your administrator.
error.protocol-error: The server gave an unexpected answer. Reload the page and try again.
error.file-missing: A file to send is missing. Select the same files again.

finalize.scanning: The antivirus is analysing the files. You can close this page: you will be notified by email when the transfer is ready.
finalize.incomplete: Some files were not completely received. The upload resumes.
finalize.blocked: Your organisation does not allow these files, the transfer was refused:
finalize.available: The transfer is ready: the recipients have been notified.
finalize.rejected: No file could be delivered: the transfer was refused after the antivirus analysis.

error.checksum-mismatch: A file was altered during the upload. Start a new transfer.
error.state-conflict: This transfer can no longer be completed. Start a new transfer.
error.transfer-gone: This transfer has expired or was deleted.
error.network: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
error.other: The transfer could not be completed. Try again later.

resume.title: Resume the interrupted upload
resume.text: An upload was interrupted. Select the same files again to continue where it stopped.
